availability_policy: Rebuilt from a CRSP vintage after month end and posted without a published release timestamp. The HTTP Last-Modified header of the zip is the only upper bound this code can observe on when a row became available; the row for month M was certainly not available during month M. Treat every observation as unavailable until at least the month after its period, and do not treat Last-Modified as the availability date of older rows.
revision_policy: Not point-in-time. The entire history is recomputed from the current source vintage on every rebuild, so observations from the 1920s can and do change between downloads. Ken French publishes no vintage archive, so a value here cannot be assumed equal to the value published at any earlier date. A sha256 identifies the file used; it does not establish what was historically available. The international files are built from a Bloomberg vintage rather than CRSP, and early history is sparse: RMW and CMA carry the -99.99 sentinel for the first years of the emerging-markets sample.
warnings: classified as returns from the banner 'Average Value Weighted Returns -- Monthly'. The file never declares its units in machine-readable form; percent is the Ken French Data Library convention and was divided by 100 to give decimals. If the source ever changes convention this parser is silently wrong, so validation.validate_table's plausibility check is not optional.

source file preamble (verbatim, the only place the file describes itself): 'This file was created using the 202606 Bloomberg database. It contains
value- and equal-weighted returns for the intersections of 2 ME portfolios
and 3 BE/ME portfolios in Developed_ex_US.

The portfolios are constructed at the end of June.  ME is market cap at the end
of June.  BE/ME is book equity at the last fiscal year end of the prior calendar
year divided by ME as of  6 months before formation.  Firms with negative
BE are not included in any portfolio.

The annual returns are from January to December.

The break points include utilities and include financials.

The portfolios include utilities and include financials.

Missing data are indicated by -99.99.'

6 separate tables were found in one file: ['average_value_weighted_returns_monthly', 'average_equal_weighted_returns_monthly', 'average_value_weighted_returns_annual', 'average_equal_weighted_returns_annual', 'number_of_firms_in_portfolios_monthly', 'average_firm_size_monthly']. Tables in one Ken French file differ in frequency and can differ in units. Never concatenate them and never assume the first one is the one you want.
